submission.natural_language_explanation: Fires retrospectively on the token just read, for a small set of specific tokens: strongest on ' enough' (about 2.5 to 3.0), then on 'Once' (always 2.34), ' until' (about 2.1 to 2.4), and on the transfer and gratitude verbs ' give', ' gave', 'Thank' and ' thanked' (about 1.3 to 1.6). Input attribution puts almost all of the activation on the firing token itself, and token identity explains nearly all activation variance (token R2 0.9985). It stays quiet on other words, including common verbs, names and adjectives.
